name: print-social-mint-green-tilted-stacked-pills-scalability-low-cost-security-slide
title: Tilted Stacked Pills Scalability Slide
whatItIs: A mint green portrait slide with dark and pale green zigzag strokes and three tilted rounded cards stacked in a cascade, 'Scalability' in green, 'Low cost' in black and 'Security trade' in white on solid green, each beside a circled logo mark, with a caption and arrow tile below.
whatItMeans: Tilted stacked cards make three attributes feel like a set of tags and add motion to a static slide.
techniques: Three colour treatments (green, black, white on green)
Circled brand mark in each card

vocabulary.definition: Cards overlapped in a descending staggered pile.
A card rotated slightly for energy.
A circled logo used as an icon.
